item.title: Teacher's aide pleads guilty to punishing disabled student with hot sauce in DC
item.description: The teacher's aide admitted to dipping her finger in hot sauce and then putting her finger in the mouth of a 9-year-old student with disabilities as a form of discipline.

item.title: Rising diesel prices hit truck drivers moving through the DMV
item.description: Gas prices are continuing to climb as tensions escalate in the Middle East, and those increases are hitting hard for people who depend on diesel fuel to make a living.

item.title: Metro assault suspect arrested by transit police again for DC assault
